name: Combat Meter
author: MarshalX
description: What your damage and healing are made of: a row per ability, your pet's included, with per-second rates, crit rate, average and biggest hit, plus your real miss and dodge rates and what is hitting you.

preview.alt: The Combat Meter panel on its Damage tab: one fight broken down per ability, six rows tinted by damage school under a total with a per-second rate, above the player attack table.

settings.label: Seconds without damage before the fight is over
Show hits, crit rate, average and biggest under each row
Show your miss, dodge and parry rates
